card.name: Adverbs and word-ends before a qualifier
card.fires_on: Adverbs and adverb-like words or word endings that sit just before a qualifying phrase, such as 'uncommonly during', 'ordinarily be', 'just a 50 percent', 'found most useful'. Also fires on a few word endings in unit or pricing terms.

modes.label: Adverb before a qualifier
modes.description: An adverb or hedge such as most, just, as or -ly that modifies the words that follow.
modes.example: have occurred uncommon<<ly>> during or following perflutren-containing

modes.label: Partway through a word or unit
modes.description: The ending of a split word or a dose unit, such as ORDINARILY or BAU/mL.
modes.example: RODUCED. ACCORDINGLY, SUCH PATIENTS SHOULD NOT ORDINAR<<IL>>Y BE CONSIDERED FOR RET
